tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje 'chang sgo rum pa chen po'i rnam thar gsol 'debs byang phyogs mkhas grub ma bzhugs so// oṃ bde legs su gyur cig byang phyogs mkhas grub bye ba'i ral pa'i spor/ /gang gi zhabs sen padmo ngal gso ba'i/ /grub pa'i 'khor los bsgyur rgyal sgo rum pa/ /rje btsun rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba kun 'dus dga' chen he ru ka /legs bshad 'dod dgu sbyin pa'i blo gros mtsho/ /gsang chen bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i dpal/ /yongs 'dzin bzang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /sngon tshe rgya chen smon lam mthu grub pas/ /mkhas grub du ma'i 'byung gnas grom stod zhes/ /grags pa'i 'od dkar chags pa'i nor 'dzin gzhir/ /grub pa'i rigs su 'khrungs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang sku chu skyes yum gyi pad rdzing las/ /gsal bar thon tshe blo gros 'dab stong rgyas/ /dpag yas yon tan sbrang rtsi'i dri bsung gis/ /kun gsal tha grur khyab la gsol ba 'debs/ /'khor ba'i khyim thab me 'obs ltar gzigs nas/ /rnam dag khrims kyi bslab pas khyod thugs gtams/ /ngur smrig rgyal mtshan bzhes tshe shākya'i sras/ /kun gyi thu bor gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i dbang phyug dam pa rnams/ /gus pas legs bsten zab dang rgya che'i chos/ /ji snyed gsan cing brtson pas sbyangs pa'i mthus/ /mkhas pa'i mkhas par grags la gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal/ /yab sras gus bsten gsang chen snyan brgyud bzhis/ /khyod thugs rab gtams rnal 'byor dbang phyug dang / /dbyer med bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /nges don mnga' bdag rje btsun jo nang pas/ /rjes bzung dpal ldan dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /drang nges rgyud don ji bzhin thugs su chud/ /rigs ldan dam pa khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos brgyad spros pa'i zlos gar rgyang bsrings nas/ /mnyam bzhag rim gnyis zab mos dus 'da' zhing /

/rdo rje sngags kyi bzlas brjod mthar phyin pa'i/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid snang brnyan dang / /'gyur med bde chen kha sbyor zab mo'i lam/ /e wam̐ zung 'jug rdo rje'i rnal 'byor las/ /nam yang g.yo ba med la gsol ba 'debs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' babs kun 'dus shing / /yi dam lha yi byin rlabs mthu grub pas/ /dam can rgya mtshos bka' la lhur len pa/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /khyod sku'i phung khams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha/ /gsung dbyangs gsang chen gzhom med rdo rje'i sgra/ /bstan 'dzin yongs kyi gtsug rgyan ngur smrig 'dzin/ /dkon mchog gsum dngos khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsang chen smin grol zab mo bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /snyan brgyud lbu 'phreng g.yo ba'i dga' ston gyis/ /skal bzang skye bo'i tshogs rnams tshim mdzad pa/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mgon khyod mthong dang thos dang dran pa dang / /zhabs rdul gus mchod gsang chen 'dzin pa'i tshogs/ /'khrul med legs pa'i lam la sbyor mdzad pa/ /'brel tshad don ldan khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma lha dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /spyan drangs me tog char 'bebs 'ja' 'od sogs/ /ngo mtshar ltas mang dang bcas 'od gsal dang / /dag pa'i zhing du gshegs la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba mchod pa bas/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i ba spu gcig mchod pa/ /khyad par 'phags zhes rgyal bas gsungs pa ltar/ /snying nas gus pas bstod pa'i dge ba des/ /bdag dang nam mkha'i mtha' klas 'gro ba rnams/ /skye dang skye ba tshe rabs thams cad du/ /rje btsun dam pa khyed kyi zhabs drung du/ /skyes nas gsung gi bdud rtsi 'thung bar shog /dal 'byor lus thob mi rtag 'chi bas bskul/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal kun rig nas/ /'gro ba'i khur khyer yang dag zab mo'i lam/

/dben pa'i gnas su rtse gcig sgom par shog /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i dngos grub mchog /sgrub byed dbang gi chu bos rgyud smin cing / /thun mong thun mong min pa'i sngon 'gro yis/ /nyams len zab mos bdag rgyud sbyong bar shog /rdo rje'i lus mchog byed bcing 'khrul 'khor ldan/ /rig pa mkha' lding rnam rtog sgyu 'phrul bcad/ g.yo med 'od gsal shes rab dga' bder ldan/ /thog mar dge ba'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin shog /zla nyi'i rgyu ba sgra gcan dbang por thim/ /tsaṇḍā li yi zla shel zhu ba'i rgyun/ /dpral bar brtan pa'i zhu bde 'gyur med kyis/ /bar du dge ba'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin shog /'khor lo drug sogs rtsa 'dab dwangs mas gang / /e wam̐ zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i dbyings/ /brjod med bde ba'i dpal la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /tha mar dge ba'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin shog /nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i rgyu ba 'gags/ /'gyur med bde chen yongs rdzogs 'bras bu'i mchog /bcu gnyis sa yi dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das/ /dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas thob par shog /gnas skabs kun tu 'gal rkyen dang bral zhing / /mthun rkyen ma lus ji ltar bsam pa ltar/ /bde blag nyid du 'grub pa'i phun tshogs kyis/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog /skyabs gsum ngo bo bla ma'i byin rlabs dang / /rigs gsum dkyil 'khor lha yi bden pa dang / /rgyud gsum dregs pa'i tshogs kyi mthu stobs kyis/ /sgo gsum bya ba chos bzhin 'grub par shog /ces rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po mkhas pa dang grub pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dbang phyug kun dga' legs pa'i blo gros dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas la rnam par thar pa dang rjes su mthun par mdor bsdus te bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa 'di ni rje de nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa can/ nor 'dzin skyong ba'i dbang po bstan pa'i mtshan can gyis yun ring mo nas gsung gis bskul ba dang /

rang nyid kyang sku drin rjes su dran pas kun nas bslangs te/ zhabs rdul gtsug gis bsten cing bka' drin chen pos 'tsho ba'i bka' 'bangs/ rgyal khams nyul ba'i bande blo gsal gyis/ yul 'dar stod gangs can ri bo'i rgyud kyi gtsug lag khang du/ sdeb sbyor gyis ma bcings pa/ go bde bar sbyar ba dge zhing bkra shis// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ sgo rum pa chen po'i rnam thar gsol 'debs byang phyogs mkhas grub ma/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
